item.title: The Largest Aircraft Ever to Land on an Aircraft Carrier
item.description: In the early Cold War years, the U.S. Navy faced a serious logistical problem. item.title: The Japanese Fighter That Almost Beat the Hellcat
item.description: The Kawanishi N1K1-J Shiden entered combat late in the Pacific War, yet it quickly earned a reputation as one of Japan’s most capable land-based fighters. Its development path was unusual. Kawanishi specialized in flying boats and floatplanes, not frontline interceptors.
